# 619: Shippingfesten er over. Eller er den det?

**Feed**: pengepodden-no  
**Published**: 2026-11-12  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In this Norwegian Pengepodden episode, Pareto Securities head of research Erik Kovalsen gives a shipping update. The 2026 tanker boom driven by the Hormuz closure looks to be rolling over: oil prices and VLCC rates are falling after Trump's midterm defeat lowered geopolitical risk, and investors are rotating out of 'unrest winners'. He calls crude tankers (Frontline, Okeanis) a trading segment rather than buy-and-hold, and prefers product tankers (Hafnia, Torm) and car carriers (Wallenius Wilhelmsen). He has a sell on Flex LNG and is cautious on dry bulk.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 HAFNI — Hafnia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest (Pareto) prefers product tankers: larger NAV discount, good dividends, rates less dependent on the Middle East.

#### Reasoning

Guest view. Product tanker rates never spiked as far as crude, so there is less downside. MR rates are still near record, and reopening Middle East refineries could add volumes. Valuation is not at a big premium to NAV.

#### Sell Triggers

- if MR product rates fall sharply
- if the tanker sector selloff deepens across all segments
- if refinery runs fall further

> *"Da synes jeg Hafne og Torm er tryggere og bedre, handler på større rabatter, gode utbytter, og ratene er mindre avhengig av Midtøsten."*

---

### 🟢 TRMD-A — Torm | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest favours Torm especially after its pullback. It pays out nearly 20% of market cap in H2.

#### Reasoning

Guest view. Torm has fallen less than crude tankers, trades at a NAV discount, has a very high dividend yield and a product market that is more independent of Hormuz. 'I would rather buy these today.'

#### Sell Triggers

- if product tanker rates collapse
- if dividend payout falls materially

> *"så derfor tror vi Hafn og Torm på relative, kanskje særlig Torm nå som har falt litt, kan funke bra"*

---

### 🟢 WAWI — Wallenius Wilhelmsen | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest likes car carriers. Expects about USD 2bn EBT next year, driven structurally by Chinese car exports and helped by lower bunker costs.

#### Reasoning

Guest view. Contracts are in place into 2029. China's car exports keep rising, falling bunker prices help Q4, and the stock has been wrongly sold off alongside Maersk and the tankers.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EU/US trade barriers sharply cut Chinese car exports
- if the car-carrier orderbook deliveries flood the market

> *"jeg liker jo disse bilaksjene, nå blir de puttet i bås med mesk"*

---

### 🔴 FLNG — Flex LNG | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Pareto has a sell (cited analyst view). It was priced on too tight a yield and has now come down; the rating will be reviewed after numbers.

#### Reasoning

Cited Pareto recommendation. LNG shipping is overvalued relative to its yield. The stock has already fallen a lot and the sell may be revisited after Q3 results.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 results and guidance surprise positively
- if Pareto lifts its sell recommendation

> *"nå kommer de også med tall i morgen for å se hva vi gjør med den salgsambefalingen da"*

---

### 🟠 OET — Okeanis Eco Tankers | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Oversold with strong numbers and a big dividend coming; possible short-term trade. Momentum is against it until rates stabilise.

#### Reasoning

Guest view. Could work as a trade after a sharp fall ahead of a large dividend, but crude tanker rates are rolling over and valuation is high, so it is not buy-and-hold.

#### Sell Triggers

- if VLCC/Suezmax rates continue to fall
- if oil price free-fall continues

> *"Kanskje som en trade i Okeanis, for det har kjempegodt tall etter børs i morgen, har falt mye, kommer med mye utbytte."*

---

### 🟡 FRO — Frontline | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Big dividends ahead (80-100 NOK over Q3+Q4) but not a no-brainer at NOK 400. Fleet growth weighs on 2028-29.

#### Reasoning

Guest view. Earnings at 80k/day give about 13% adjusted yield, but rates are rolling over, the orderbook is high and delivery years are getting worse. A trading segment; other names are more interesting.

#### Sell Triggers

- if VLCC rates fall toward 50-60k/day
- if fleet growth accelerates

> *"Så det er liksom ikke no-brainer å ta tak i frontline på 400 kroner i dag."*

---
